bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls enabling regulated insurers to safely adopt analytics and ML capabilities, establishing a governed deployment pattern for AI-enabled workloads.
Established a shared responsibility operating-model framework delineating AWS-managed controls from insurer-owned controls to support governed cloud deployment.
Led AWS modernization execution for monolithic policy administration and insurance platform workloads, driving legacy-to-cloud migration.
